env.//: Optional: set SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY for higher Semantic Scholar rate limits. arXiv, PubMed, bioRxiv, medRxiv and Europe PMC work without any key.

Replace with your own email. OpenAlex needs no key; a contact email in OPENALEX_MAILTO is sent as mailto= to join the faster 'polite pool'. (An API key, if you have one, goes in OPENALEX_API_KEY instead.)
